The [[Reena University/Legends|Reena University]] had maintained a vast [[megacomputer]] '''archive''' that conlained information on
the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]: its history, geography, and political history were included. Scientific data, [[NewsNet|newsnet]] files, court proceedings, and out-of-sector information round out the various tidbits stored here. The archive was situated on its own island, and not only was the land protected with [[Guard droid/Legends|guard droid]]s, but the surrounding waters were patrolled by the university security staff. The archives were open to all, but accessing them was not cheap.<ref name="LotE" />
